name: ZOWIE Gaming Mouse
notes: 69-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real ZOWIE Gaming Mouse, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/946d9053509ffb9aeee8deeb3c3096b4/test-zowie-ec2a.txt. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
